dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Tell me about your headache. When did it begin and where do you mainly feel the pain?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I have had the headache for about four days. Most of the pain is across my forehead and near my temples.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He has also been sleeping very poorly for the last few nights. He wakes up several times and looks exhausted in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: Dad has been really tired after work too. Yesterday he fell asleep on the sofa much earlier than usual.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you noticed blurred vision, weakness, numbness, vomiting, or anything unusual?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No. I have not had blurred vision, weakness, numbness, or vomiting.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you taken any medicine for the headache?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I took ibuprofen this morning and I also took some yesterday evening.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Did the ibuprofen make a noticeable difference?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Only a little. The headache became less intense for a while but it did not completely disappear.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He has also been working late this week, so I wonder whether the lack of sleep is making the headache worse.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: That is useful information. I will check his blood pressure and perform a neurological exam before deciding what we should do next.
